landing.title: The map, the cast, and the routes of your table — in one place.
landing.lede: Campaign Codex is the living codex for tabletop RPG campaigns — a real map players explore, a relationship network, and a GM who edits it all on the same screen.
landing.checkNoAccount: No account for players — just open the link
landing.checkSelfHosted: Self-hosted — table data stays with the GM
landing.stepMapBody: Zoom and pan like a real map. Pins reveal only what the party has discovered.
landing.stepRelBody: Who is ally, who is foe, who hides what — a graph players explore on their own.
landing.stepRouteBody: Plan travel along roads, rivers, and trails the GM drew on the map.
landing.genresLead: Each campaign picks a genre at creation, and the UI adapts. Try it:

explorar.lead: No account, no password — pick a table and jump straight into the map.
